scientific_integrity: Exact Eulerian proof and external classical marginals are identified separately; finite exhaustive checks supplement but do not prove unrestricted assertions.
scientific_limitations: Uniform permutations and classical unbiased walks only; exact occupation–endpoint covariance and strict comparison, not a full joint distribution; the limiting correlation also follows from pre-existing Brownian invariance principles. Historical priority not independently certified.
title: Identical arcsine occupation laws conceal a strict endpoint-covariance gap
